doc_title_en: Notice of Revision to Full-Year Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
doc_title_jp: 通期業績予想の修正および配当予想の修正（増配）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 通期個別業績予想を踏まえ、期末配当金を修正

summary_en: Year-end dividend raised to ¥30.00/share from ¥25.00/share. Full-year profit forecast revised upward to ¥480M net income (from ¥360M) and ¥99.56 EPS (from ¥74.67), driven by higher semiconductor equipment casting demand and price increases. Payout ratio not disclosed.
summary_jp: 期末配当を1株当たり30円に引き上げ（従来25円）。通期純利益予想を480百万円に上方修正（従来360百万円）、1株当たり利益は99.56円（従来74.67円）。半導体製造装置向け需要増と販売価格改定が主因。
tag_en: Dividend – Year-end raised from ¥25.00 to ¥30.00 per share
